999008199.text:
ここがララ・ビーチグランプリの会場……
海、綺麗ね……

localizations.en: So this is the venue for the Lara Beach Grand Prix... The ocean is beautiful...

999008199.text:
眩しい日差しに、涼しい風、
匂ってくる磯の香り……まさに風光明媚！

localizations.en: Dazzling sunlight, cool breeze, the scent of the sea in the air... It's absolutely scenic!

999008199.text:
こんないいところで大会を開くんだし、
お客さんもたくさん来るんじゃないかな？

localizations.en: Since they're holding the tournament in such a wonderful place, I bet lots of people will come!

999008199.text:
うん、ララの大会は成功してほしいけど……
私は、あんまり注目を浴びたくないわ……

localizations.en: Yeah, I want Lara's tournament to be a success, but... I don't really want to attract too much attention...

999008199.text:
この水着姿で注目を浴びないなんてことは
ないんじゃないかな。すっごくかわいいから

localizations.en: I don't think there's any way you won't attract attention in that swimsuit. You look super cute!

999008199.text: うう……やっぱり恥ずかしい……

ほら、二人とも、なにやってるのよ！
造った船とか、試運転するわよ！

localizations.en: Hey, you two, what are you doing?! Let's test run the boats and stuff we made!

999008199.text:
そうだね。色々試行錯誤してたら、
何日もかかって開催前日になっちゃったし……

localizations.en: You're right. We spent so many days experimenting and trying different things, it's already the day before the event...

999008199.text:
って、あれ？　なんか向こうが騒がしいけど、
どうしたんだろう？

localizations.en: Huh? Wait, it sounds pretty noisy over there. What's going on?

999008199.text:
暑い所の海だから、どこかの馬鹿が騒いでるのよ。
まあ、せっかくならその馬鹿面を拝んでやろうじゃない

localizations.en: It's a hot beach, so some idiot's probably making a fuss. Well, might as well go check out what kind of idiot face we're dealing with.

999008199.text: ふふ……見に行きましょ。どんな馬鹿面なのか

localizations.en: Hehe... Let's go see. What kind of idiot face is it?

999008199.text: 変なところで気が合うんだね……

localizations.en: You two have such weird timing when you agree on things...

999008199.text: 魔物が出るなんて、聞いてないんですけど～！

localizations.en: Nobody told me monsters would show up here!

999008199.text:
そりゃあ、魔物がここに出ますよ～って
事前に教えてくれたら助かるだろうぜ！

localizations.en: Well, it'd sure be helpful if they gave us a heads up saying 'Hey, monsters are gonna show up here!'

999008199.text: あら、どこかで見た面ね

アルビーナにマクダさん！？
どうしたんですか！？
話は後。魔物を倒すわよ

localizations.en: We'll talk later. Let's take down the monsters.
